name: triage-issue
summary: Every 30 minutes, give each new issue from another person a first verdict: a duplicate, a bug, a feature or more information needed, with the reason and an estimated size.

points.question: What happens before the triage reply is posted?

options.label: A person approves
options.summary: One approval decision shows the verdict and the reply. Nothing is posted before the approval. A denial adds only cloving: triaged.
options.change: Keep askPerson as decidePost from triage-issue/post.ts in triage-issue.ts. Keep selection.post as person in triage-issue/scenarios.ts.

options.label: Post at once
options.summary: Post the reply and add the labels without a decision.
options.change: In triage-issue.ts replace askPerson as decidePost with postAtOnce as decidePost in the triage-issue/post.ts import. Set selection.post to now in triage-issue/scenarios.ts.
